- `a12-release--auto-rollback`: - `to_agent`: A13. `goal`: take the incident for the rolled-back release. `completed`: breach confirmed, rollback issued at the step reached. `remaining`: verify stabilisation, declare the incident, post-incident review. `decisions`: why rollback, with the metrics. `artifacts`: the rollback file and digest, producer A12. `constraints`: no promote until A13 clears it. `verification`: verified only when step 1 ran. - Call `shared_handover_validate` with `draft: true`, then `shared_handover_write`.

- `a12-release--delivery-metrics`: - `to_agent`: A13 (A14 gets the same document in a second write). `goal`: delivery health for the window. `completed`: the four metrics with targets. `open_questions`: excluded records and thin samples. `decisions`: the daily-capability reading and the MTTR rule. `verification`: verified only when all four calls ran. - Call `shared_handover_validate` with `draft: true`, then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a12-release--freeze-on-incident`: - `to_agent`: A01. `goal`: swarm freeze state after the incident. `completed`: alerts judged, freeze required or lift refused. `blockers`: the alert ids holding the freeze, and the pending operator step. `constraints`: no promotion until the authority lifts it. `decisions`: freeze or refuse with `reason`. `verification`: verified when `rel_freeze_decision` ran. - Call `shared_handover_validate` with `draft: true`, then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a12-release--gate-conjunction`: - `to_agent`: A01. `goal`: gate verdict for the release. `completed`: each gate with age and status. `remaining`: producer rework or promotion. `blockers`: expired, unwaived, failed or missing gates. `decisions`: pass or fail with the rule applied. `verification`: verified only when steps 1 to 5 all ran. - Call `shared_handover_validate` with `draft: true`, then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a12-release--high-risk-approval`: - `to_agent`: A01 (routes to the humans). `goal`: obtain L4 four-eyes approval for the release. `completed`: evidence packet. `remaining`: two human approvals, then promotion planning. `blockers`: `human-approval: prod_high_risk`. `constraints`: no promote before approval. `verification`: partial when any gate is stale. - Call `shared_handover_validate` with `draft: true`, then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a12-release--monitoring-degraded-halt`: - `to_agent`: A13. `goal`: restore the guardrail telemetry for `<release_id>`. `completed`: halted at the step. `remaining`: telemetry back, then a decision. `blockers`: the missing metrics. `constraints`: the release does not advance until a full sample is judged. `verification`: verified (the halt itself is certain). - Call `shared_handover_validate` with `draft: true`, then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a12-release--plan-canary`: - `to_agent`: A01. `goal`: gate and queue release `<release_id>`. `completed`: plan written, steps and approval class. `remaining`: gate conjunction and promotion. `decisions`: risk class and approval class with rationale. `artifacts`: the plan file with its digest, producer A12. `verification`: verified only when steps 2 to 5 all ran. - Call `shared_handover_validate` with `draft: true`, then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a12-release--provenance-precheck`: - `to_agent`: A11 when blocked (`goal`: supply a signed, attested artifact whose sha matches the head), otherwise A01. `completed`: sha and artifact checks. `blockers`: each failed check. `artifacts`: the build.artifact entries with digests, producer A11. `verification`: verified only when steps 2 to 5 ran. - Call `shared_handover_validate` with `draft: true`, then `shared_handover_write`.
